name: Microsoft Olive GitHub README
notes: Olive = Onnx LIVE, MIT, 2.4k stars, 2021 commits. 'Given a model and targeted hardware, Olive composes the best suitable optimization techniques to output the most efficient ONNX model(s).' NPU support shipped in Olive 0.9.0 (May 2025), new quantization algorithms in 0.8.0 (Mar 2025) and 0.9.2 (Aug 2025). Recipes relocated to a separate olive-recipes repo in Sep 2025. | SOURCE AUDIT 2026-10-03: the 'published' field held a verbatim copy of this notes paragraph instead of a date (field corruption across the qlab2-* batch); published set to null because a GitHub README, doc page or source header has no reliable publication date of its own. Content of the document itself was re-verified live 2026-10-03 and the notes are correct.
